A '''situation tracking sensor''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. [[Metrocab Robo-Hack Landspeeder]]s had a bank of the sensors installed above their forward headlights which assisted the vehicle with high-speed lane changing.<ref name="EGTD" />
